newsitem.title: USA: Maverick Tube stake cut by investor.
newsitem.headline: Maverick Tube stake cut by investor.

text.p: A group led by St Louis investor John Weil said Thursday it cut its stake in Maverick Tube Corp to 480,000 common shares or 6.45 percent from 8.18 percent previously held.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions included the sale of 131,000 common shares between April 2 and April 16 at prices ranging from $18.750 to $21.25 per share.
Marverick Tube, based in Chesterfield, Mo., manufactures electric resistance welded pipe used in oil and gas wells.
